newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Official denies South Koreans taken hostage.
newsitem.headline: Official denies South Koreans taken hostage.

text.p: A South Korean Defence Ministry official denied a state television report that two South Koreans had been taken hostage by North Korean infiltrators.
"The story was wrong," Major Kim Myong-shik, a Defence Ministry official, told Reuters, referring to the report on the Korea Broadcasting System.

The state television broadcaster had also reported a stand-off between the North Koreans and Southern troops in the east coast area where it said the hostages had been taken after picking mushrooms on a mountain.
"We are not doing military operations at that spot," said Kim, who is based in the east coast city of Kangnung.
But Kim said there were two people considered missing after last being seen on Tuesday picking mushrooms in the area.
Other local media also said later the hostage drama appeared to have been a false report.
